steps.en: Register the server in your MCP client once
steps.zh: 在 MCP 客户端里登记一次这个服务
steps.code: claude mcp add --transport stdio windows-mcp -- uvx windows-mcp serve

steps.en: Starts on your Windows session over stdio and exposes Click, Type, Snapshot, App and more
steps.zh: 在你的 Windows 会话里经 stdio 启动，暴露点击、输入、快照等工具

steps.en: Ask the agent in plain words to do a task in a native Windows app
steps.zh: 用大白话让 agent 去某个原生 Windows 程序里办事

steps.en: Reads the window's accessibility tree into labelled, clickable elements with coordinates
steps.zh: 读窗口的无障碍树，列出带编号和坐标的可点元素

steps.en: Turns the chosen label into screen coordinates and injects real mouse and keyboard input
steps.zh: 把选中的编号换成屏幕坐标，注入真实的鼠标键盘输入

value.en: The agent works native Windows apps by element name, not hard-coded pixels, and you write no automation script
value.zh: agent 按控件名而不是写死的像素去操作原生 Windows 程序，你不用写一行自动化脚本

sources: README.md — Install in Claude Code: 'claude mcp add --transport stdio windows-mcp -- uvx windows-mcp serve'; Running Windows-MCP: 'uvx windows-mcp serve' (stdio default)
README.md — MCP Tools list (Click, Type, Snapshot, Screenshot, App, PowerShell, FileSystem, ...)
src/windows_mcp/tools/snapshot.py — Snapshot description: interactive elements with coordinates, scrollable areas, use_dom
src/windows_mcp/tools/input.py — Click/Type take 'loc' or 'label'; _resolve_label converts a UI element label to screen coordinates
